info.title: ce
info.description: Ultra-fast code graph exploration & architecture mapping CLI and MCP server

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize a .codeexplorer workspace in the current or specified directory.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Target directory to initialize (defaults to current working directory).

options.name: --force
options.description: Reinitialize workspace and overwrite existing database if already present. [default: False]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Workspace name (defaults to current folder name).

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Scan and index a directory into the nearest workspace.

options.name: --clear
options.description: Clear previous data for this path before scanning. [default: False]

options.name: --intent
options.description: Run LLM architectural intent distillation (cached intents are applied automatically by default). [default: False]

options.name: --watch
options.description: Watch directory for file changes and reindex incrementally in background. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to scan and index (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: index
commands.description: Alias for 'scan': index a directory into the nearest workspace.

options.name: --clear
options.description: Clear previous data for this path before scanning. [default: False]

options.name: --intent
options.description: Run LLM architectural intent distillation (cached intents are applied automatically by default). [default: False]

options.name: --watch
options.description: Watch directory for file changes and reindex incrementally in background. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to scan and index (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show status and summary of the nearest workspace.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Starting directory to look for workspace (defaults to current directory).

options.name: --json
options.description: Output status in JSON format. [default: False]

commands.name: info
commands.description: Alias for 'status': show summary of the nearest workspace.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Starting directory to look for workspace (defaults to current directory).

options.name: --json
options.description: Output status in JSON format. [default: False]

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clear indexed data from the nearest workspace database.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation prompt when clearing. [default: False]

options.name: --dir
options.description: Starting directory to look for workspace (defaults to current directory).

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Specific sub-path to clear from the graph. If omitted, clears entire database.

commands.name: queries
commands.description: Lists all available built-in and workspace custom queries.

options.name: --query
options.description: The Cypher query string to execute (alternative to positional argument).

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to a .cypher file to execute.

options.name: --name
options.description: Name of a built-in or custom query to execute.

options.name: --list
options.description: List all available built-in and workspace custom queries.

options.name: --show
options.description: Display the Cypher source code of a built-in or custom query by name.

options.name: --db-path
options.description: Explicit SQLite database path (defaults to nearest .codeexplorer/graph.db).

options.description: Starting directory to look for workspace (defaults to current directory).

options.name: --json
options.description: Output results as formatted JSON (alias for --format json).

options.name: --param

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Starts the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the nearest workspace (stdio by default).

options.name: --db-path
options.description: Explicit SQLite database path (defaults to nearest .codeexplorer/graph.db).

options.name: --port
options.description: HTTP port to run as an SSE network service (0 for stdio). [default: 0]

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Target AI tool when action is 'configure' or 'setup'.

commands.name: ingest
commands.description: Recursively parses a directory and loads structural nodes into the SQLite graph database.

options.name: --dir
options.description: The codebase directory to scan and parse.

options.name: --clear
options.description: Whether to surgically clear only this workspace's previous data before ingestion.

options.name: --clear-all
options.description: Whether to perform a global database clear of all workspaces before ingestion.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export architecture and system topology diagrams in Mermaid or C4 format.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path (prints to stdout if omitted).

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Starts the real-time WebSocket and HTTP API server for CodeExplorer.

options.name: --port
options.description: Port to listen on (0 for automatically allocated ephemeral port). [default: 0]

options.name: --idle-timeout
options.description: Seconds of inactivity with 0 connected clients before automatic shutdown (0 to disable). [default: 30]

commands.name: view
commands.description: View architectural projections (C1 system context, C2 service flow, C3 component, domain map, tiered).

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: dependencies
commands.description: Inspect project dependencies with runtime vs build filtering.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: deps
commands.description: Alias for 'dependencies'. Inspect project dependencies.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: contracts
commands.description: List ingress and egress service communication contracts (HTTP endpoints, gRPC calls, message publishers/subscribers).

options.name: --service
options.description: Name of the service or project.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Trace cross-service execution flow from an entry point or service.

options.name: --entry
options.description: Optional entry point or endpoint URL.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: intent
commands.description: Enrich graph with architectural intents using native LLM distillation.

options.name: --service
options.description: Filter analysis to specific service or comma-separated list of services (e.g. -s order-service,payment-service).

options.name: --domains-only
options.description: Only synthesize and materialize macro-domains from project signatures without running per-file LLM distillation. [default: False]

options.name: --deep
options.description: Enable multi-turn agentic graph exploration loop (ReAct) for local LLM. [default: False]

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum number of candidate files to analyze in this pass.

options.name: --reanalyze
options.description: Force re-analysis of selected files or services, bypassing the content-hash cache. [default: False]

options.name: --clear
options.description: Clear all cached intent records for this workspace. [default: False]

options.name: --reset-errors
options.description: Reset error counter for files that failed distillation previously. [default: False]

options.name: --stop
options.description: Stop any active intent distillation process running for this workspace. [default: False]

options.name: --status
options.description: Check status of the intent distillation process for this workspace. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Force stop any existing intent process before starting a new run. [default: False]

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: Custom OpenAI-compatible API endpoint URL (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1).

options.name: --model
options.description: Model name for custom API endpoint (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:7b).

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Optional API key for custom API endpoint.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to workspace or directory to enrich (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: model
commands.description: Manage local LLM models for CodeExplorer intent distillation.

options.name: --force
options.description: Force re-download even if model file already exists. [default: False]

commands.name: domain
commands.description: Manage architectural domains, metadata, and service-to-domain overrides.

options.name: --domain
options.description: Target domain name when assigning a service.

options.name: --context
options.description: Bounded context name when assigning a service.

options.name: --display
options.description: Human-readable display name for the domain.

options.name: --desc
options.description: Description of the domain's business capabilities.

options.name: --reassign
options.description: Target domain to reassign services to when removing a domain.

options.name: --root
options.description: Workspace root directory (defaults to current directory).

arguments.name: NAMEORSERVICE
arguments.description: Domain name (for add/remove) or service name (for assign/unassign).

commands.name: test
commands.description: Test Impact Analysis (TIA): find exact test methods affected by changed files or git diff.

options.name: --files
options.description: Comma-separated list of changed file paths.

options.name: --git
options.description: Inspect working git diff against HEAD.

options.name: --git-base
options.description: Base branch or commit for git diff (e.g. 'origin/main', 'HEAD~1').

options.name: --symbols
options.description: Comma-separated list of modified symbol names.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).

options.name: --project
options.description: Filter by project name (when subcommand is 'coverage').

options.name: --threshold
options.description: Minimum required coverage percentage (fails with exit code 1 if below).

commands.name: coverage
commands.description: Analyze static test reachability coverage: list covered and uncovered classes & methods.

options.name: --project
options.description: Filter analysis to a specific project name.

options.name: --path
options.description: Filter analysis to files matching path prefix.

options.name: --uncovered-only
options.description: Display only uncovered classes and methods. [default: False]

options.name: --covered-only
options.description: Display only covered classes and methods. [default: False]

options.name: --threshold
options.description: Minimum acceptable method coverage percentage for CI gating.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: configure
commands.description: Configure MCP servers and agent rules for AI tools (antigravity, cursor, claude, claude-code, windsurf, vscode, cline, zed, all).

options.name: --rules
options.description: Automatically provision AI agent rules / instructions (e.g. .cursorrules, CLAUDE.md). [default: True]

options.name: --remove
options.description: Remove CodeExplorer configuration from the specified tool.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show proposed configuration changes without modifying files.

options.name: --verify
options.description: Test JSON-RPC communication with ce mcp server.

options.name: --root
options.description: Workspace root directory (defaults to current workspace).

arguments.name: CATEGORY
arguments.description: Category to configure (e.g. 'mcp') or target tool directly.

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Target AI tool: antigravity, cursor, claude, claude-code, windsurf, vscode, cline, zed, all.
